verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents a first-party Drop Logs capability that filters out unwanted logs to reduce costs. This is a deliberate log-volume control the product itself provides. The evidence does not show trace sampling, log sampling rates, or configurable retention periods or tiers, so only a thin slice of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: trace sampling configuration, log sampling controls, retention period/tier settings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately

citations.quote: Drop Logs — Filter out unwanted logs to reduce costs.
